name: GL Tech Co.,Ltd
summary: GL Tech Co.,Ltd provides safety production monitoring equipment and semiconductor packaging and testing equipment in China and internationally. It offers semiconductor cutting, dicing, and thinning machines for wafer dicing, package dicing, and wafer thinning process in packaging and testing. The company also offers sensors, transmitters, detection instruments, control systems, safety equipment, environmental protection equipment, and electromechanical equipment.
